scope: Native SQLite read through the Release-optimized Mail index. The previous live path read rows, total/loading/unread counts, and on deep full pages a separate next row. The new list window reads visible rows and one raw lookahead and projects only list counts within one snapshot. The unread badge retains its full read. Each mode verifies the same ordered IDs, row signatures, loading, totals, lower-bound status and continuation. Display rendering and time to first visible row are outside this interval.

protocol.Mac: Seeded on disk, fresh process per mode and scope, six reads per process. Reference/candidate/candidate/reference order. Trial 0 is fresh-process, 1–4 warm, 5 releases GRDB connection caches. The OS filesystem cache remains uncontrolled.
protocol.iPhone: Same signed local benchmark and database per launch, with reference/candidate/candidate/reference in one launch and the reverse order in another. Database connections release memory between scenarios and before trial 5. All timings use ContinuousClock. No personal mailbox data.
